commands.title: OS10 version and uptime

commands.title: Hardware inventory
commands.description: List chassis, components, product identifiers, and serial numbers.

commands.title: System status
commands.description: Show switch identity, system health, uptime, and management state.

commands.title: Interface status
commands.description: Summarize physical port link, mode, VLAN, speed, and media state.

commands.description: Compare packet, byte, discard, and error counters across ports.
